title: License Selection Advisor
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Apply three questions to choose the license that serves each of seven stated creator goals.

learningObjectives: The learner will apply the three license-selection questions to choose the license that serves each of seven stated goals, with at least 6 of 7 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The idea of license selection and the licenses CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-ND, and CC BY-NC-ND

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Will you allow others to share changed versions?
Must changed versions carry the same license?
commonMisconceptions: The most restrictive license is always the safest
CC0 is just another Creative Commons license with no conditions on commercial use
ShareAlike and NoDerivatives can be combined
assessmentOpportunities: Others may change my lesson noncommercially, and every changed version must carry my license. Which license?
Anyone may share my finished report, even for sale, but nobody may share a changed version. Which license?
When is CC0 the right choice?
Name two checks to make before you pick any license.

controls.name: Seven license buttons
controls.description: CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-ND.
